verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say it supports customizable notifications for form entries, and independent community comments list 'forms/webhooks' among its features. Together these suggest outbound webhooks exist at least for form events, though none of the evidence documents how to register them or which events are covered. missing for 10: first-party documentation of registrable outbound HTTP webhook endpoints, coverage of event types beyond forms (e.g. deploy events), payload/signing details, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
